description: Source code for a base class implementing an LLM service using the AsyncOpenAI client, including methods for configuration, streaming completions, inference, and frame processing.

classes.name: BaseOpenAILLMService
classes.description: A base class for services utilizing the AsyncOpenAI client, managing configuration, streaming, inference, and frame processing.

methods.name: create_client
methods.description: Creates and configures an AsyncOpenAI client instance with provided API key, URL, and headers.

methods.name: can_generate_metrics
methods.description: Indicates that this service supports metrics generation.

methods.name: set_full_model_name
methods.description: Sets the full model name used for identification.

methods.name: get_full_model_name
methods.description: Retrieves the current full model name.

methods.name: get_chat_completions
methods.description: Streams chat completions from OpenAI with optional timeout and retry logic.

methods.name: build_chat_completion_params
methods.description: Constructs parameters for chat completion requests based on context.

methods.name: run_inference
methods.description: Performs a one-off inference call with the given LLM context.

methods.name: _stream_chat_completions_specific_context
methods.description: Streams chat completions based on a specific OpenAILLMContext.

methods.name: _stream_chat_completions_universal_context
methods.description: Streams chat completions based on a universal LLMContext.

methods.name: _process_context
methods.description: Processes the LLM context, handling streaming chunks, function calls, and frame updates.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Handles different frame types to trigger LLM processing and manage settings.
